title: Code R (Demo)
overview:
I Want to Keep Watching You as You Keep On Driving...

You lost your mother as a child and live with your father above his bicycle shop. After saving from part-time jobs for your own car, you discover an account your mother left in your name holding 3 million yen - and without asking anyone, you spend it on your dream machine, a Nissan Fairlady Z S30.

Code R is a racing adventure that mixes a story of romance and rivalry with real-time 3D mountain pass racing. Travel around town on the map, meet rivals and girls, go on dates and take part-time jobs. Win races to earn money and reputation, then spend it repairing damage, buying upgrades and fine-tuning your car's settings.

This disc is a demo version of the game.

- 1 player
- Racing controller and multi controller support
